[[File:Nintendo-Game-Boy-Advance-Purple-FL.jpg|thumb|Game Boy Advance]]
This is a list of video games for the [[Game Boy Advance]] [[video game console]] that have sold or shipped at least one million copies. The best-selling games on the Game Boy Advance are [[Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire|''Pokémon Ruby'' and ''Sapphire'']]. First released in Japan on November 21, 2002, they went on to sell over 16{{nbsp}}million units worldwide.<ref name="pokemon1">{{cite news |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/pokemon-x-y-sells-4-million-in-two-days/1100-6415582/ |title=Pokemon X/Y sells 4 million in two days |last=Makuch |first=Eddie |work=[[GameSpot]] |publisher=[[CBS Interactive]] |date=October 15, 2013 |accessdate=April 25, 2017 }}</ref> [[Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen|''Pokémon FireRed'' and ''LeafGreen'']], enhanced remakes of the original [[Pokémon Red and Blue|''Pokémon Red'', ''Green'' and ''Blue'']] games, are the second-best-selling games on the platform with sales in excess of 12{{nbsp}}million units combined.<ref name="pokemon1"/> ''[[Pokémon Emerald]]'', an enhanced version of ''Ruby'' and ''Sapphire'', is third with sales of more than 7{{nbsp}}million units.<ref name="pokemon2">{{cite news |url=http://www.usgamer.net/articles/pokemon-sun-and-moon-sells-1469-million-copies-xy-passes-blackwhite |title=Pokemon Sun and Moon Sells 14.69 Million Copies, X&Y Passes Black & White |last=Williams |first=Mike |work=[[Eurogamer|USgamer]] |publisher=Gamer Network |date=January 31, 2017 |accessdate=April 25, 2017 }}</ref> The top five is rounded out by ''[[Mario Kart: Super Circuit]]'' and ''[[Super Mario World: Super Mario Advance 2]]'', each of which sold over 5.5{{nbsp}}million units.<ref name="supermariotitles">{{cite web |url=http://www.gizmodo.co.uk/2015/09/30-best-selling-super-mario-games-of-all-time-on-the-plumbers-30th-birthday/ |title=30 Best-Selling Super Mario Games of All Time on the Plumber's 30th Birthday |last=O'Malley |first=James |work=[[Gizmodo]] |publisher=[[Univision Communications]] |date=September 11, 2015 |accessdate=April 25, 2017 }}</ref>

There are a total of 40 Game Boy Advance games on this list which are confirmed to have sold or shipped at least one million units. Of these, eleven were developed internally by Nintendo development divisions. Other developers with the most million-selling games include [[Game Freak]] with three games, and [[HAL Laboratory]] and [[Flagship (company)|Flagship]], with two games each. Of the 40 games on this list, 25 were published in one or more regions by Nintendo. Other publishers with multiple million-selling games include [[The Pokémon Company]] with five games, [[THQ]] with three games, and [[Konami]] and [[Namco]] with two games each. The most popular franchises on Game Boy Advance include ''[[Pokémon]]'' (over 39{{nbsp}}million combined units) and ''[[Super Mario]]'' (16.69{{nbsp}}million combined units).
